language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hola! My name is Sofia. I’m at my favorite Mexican diner to have lunch with my friend Luis. I just returned from a trip around the world with my family!
I love to take pictures and have many photos of animals and plants that I saw in different habitats. I’m working on putting them into my scrapbook.
Did you know that a habitat is a place where an organism lives? A suitable habitat must provide 5 things: Food, water, shelter, space, and air.
Organisms thrive when they are in a habitat that best suits their needs. For example, polar bears can live in cold temperatures because they are covered in warm fur.
I was lucky to be able to explore five different habitats on my trip: a desert, a rainforest, the Arctic, mountains, and an ocean.
I have so many photos and notes that I haven’t had time to finish my scrapbook about habitats around the world. Will you help me work on it?
You’ll be able to learn more about habitats by helping Sofia complete all the exercises in this lesson. You can click on me any time for help!

activities.subtitle: A walrus eats clams, snails and crabs. It lives in shallow water by ice floes or land. It has blubber under their skin to protect them from cold water.

activities.title: Which habitat is best for this animal? Click on the correct option.
activities.subtitle: A goat grazes vegetation found on ledges and cliff faces. It can survive at high altitudes and moves well on steep, rocky surfaces.

activities.title: Which habitat is best for this animal? Click on the correct option.
activities.subtitle: The red-eyed tree frog eats mostly insects and lives near ponds, streams and rivers. It has suction cups on its toes so it can climb trees.

activities.title: Which habitat is best for this animal? Click on the correct option.
activities.subtitle: Bottlenose dolphins, mainly in temperate and tropical waters, hunt in groups, utilizing blowholes to breathe as they are mammals.

activities.title: Which habitat is best for this animal? Click on the correct option.
activities.subtitle: The sidewinder rattlesnake eats small rodents. It lives buried in the sand or in animal burrows. It is pale to brown in color so it can blend in with the sand.

Now I know a lot about animals and their habitats. I have a test at school next week on plant habitats. Will you help me study by figuring out if these statements about plants are true or false?

helperSimple.text: Look at the photo and read the fact about the plant to help you determine if each statement is true or false. Click on the true or false button to complete the activity.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: The cork oak tree provides shade for the people who live in sunny areas.

questions.text: Cork oak tree can grow at high altitudes, and its thick bark can be harversted as cork without harming the tree.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: The big-leaf mahogany tree grows well in the rainforest.

questions.text: Big-leaf mahogany tree has wide branches to absorb as much sunlight as possible to produce food.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: A bearberry plant can survive in the Arctic.

questions.text: Bearberry is a plant with silky hairs and leathery leaves that keep it warm.

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: A mesquite tree grows well in the desert.

questions.text: A mesquite tree stores water in deep roots to survive hot and dry conditions

activities.title: Is this statement true or false?
activities.subtitle: Kelp provides a good habitat for other ocean organisms.

questions.text: Kelp is a seaweed that provides shelter and food for many types of sea creatures.

outro.text: Thanks for helping me study plant habitats. Great job!
